original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 4 Socket Designation maps uniquely to the approved platform socket topology, including the expected treatment of populated and unpopulated sockets, and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture every complete Type 4 record, preserve handles and Status/population evidence, normalize designation strings, correlate populated records with OS CPU topology where appropriate, compare the full socket set and mapping to the platform recipe, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected socket topology, designation normalization and reboot plan. Complete record parsing and topology comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved physical socket count and designation set
Expected Type 4 records for populated/unpopulated sockets
Mapping policy between Type 4 records and OS CPU/package inventory
Validated dmidecode/transport and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS and OS topology only; do not hotplug CPUs, change affinity or alter firmware.
Preserve all Type 4 records and errors; grep fragments are not the complete socket set.
Do not discard unpopulated-socket records or require OS CPU mapping for an unpopulated socket unless the platform recipe does.
Reject blank, duplicate or unexpected designations and distinguish record-handle churn from semantic socket mapping.
Stop on missing/duplicate topology, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 4 and OS package evidence, classify each record's population status, normalize designations and compare the complete socket topology before/after reboot.
Do not modify CPU state, infer unapproved physical labeling or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected designation set, population policy and OS correlation rules.
Resolve firmware-versus-board-label topology discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is correct, but grep loses the rest of each processor record, cannot classify populated/unpopulated sockets, suppresses errors and assumes insecure transport.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full `dmidecode -t 4` output plus tool/errors and OS package topology; parse every record by handle and retain designation with Status and stable processor identity fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 4 Socket Designation scope, processor script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a record-scoped socket table containing handle, normalized designation, population Status and stable processor identity; compare it with the approved physical socket topology and separately correlate populated entries to OS packages.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 4 systems, including multi-socket and partially populated servers.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, CPU and platform recipe revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved platform socket topology and installed dmidecode/OS topology documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete-set, population-state and cross-source topology validation without altering the source field.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; adds missing/duplicate/unpopulated socket detection.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected socket set and population mapping policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Socket labels are platform strings; lexical order need not equal physical or OS package order.

project_override_considerations: A project may define its designation naming/order and whether unpopulated sockets receive Type 4 records, but must preserve the full set and cannot validate only the first populated processor.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected socket/designation/population map and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 4 table plus OS package correlation for populated sockets

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and criteria coherently target Type 4 Socket Designation persistence; topology details are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field and read path are clear; expected topology and population policy determine readiness.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Replaces line-oriented extraction with full multi-socket record context.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps complete topology and recovery while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds explicit populated/unpopulated handling, semantic-versus-handle stability and bounded OS correlation.

review_improvement: Prevents a single correct line from hiding missing, duplicated, mislabeled or unexpectedly unpopulated processor sockets.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once the platform socket map is approved, collection and comparison of all Type 4/OS topology evidence are software-controlled; no physical operation is inherent in the source row.
